acceptance: Issue #901 is closed as completed with root-cause, fix-commit, and fresh-adopter regression evidence; its fix is present on the selected release source.

The same-SHA 85.10% coverage boundary is deterministic: the lock-lease malformed-metadata path is covered by a non-racy regression test, and release-blocking quality aggregation passes without relying on concurrent timing.
make check-release-readiness passes on the synchronized latest origin/main and identifies v0.5.68 as the only eligible next candidate.

After Work Item archive and pre-merge freeze, a same-SHA release.yml rehearsal succeeds for v0.5.68; its private receipt binds the exact source SHA, tree, strict smoke evidence, required jobs, coverage, and artifact digests, and no v0.5.68 tag or Release exists before publication.

The actual release.yml run consumes that exact successful rehearsal receipt and publishes v0.5.68 only after exact-source preflight, dependency/CI evidence, source-bound SBOM/provenance/digest evidence, tagged Quick Install, and Draft Release validation pass.

Independent post-publication checks verify the immutable tag target, stable provider Release, public release.json/sbom.json/provenance.json/release-digests.json assets, archive checksum, installer identity, release-state consistency, and adopter Quick Install for v0.5.68.

Lifecycle synchronization and resume history remain preserved as evidence but do not inflate the repeatedProtocolFields complexity metric; the regression test and full quality gate pass without increasing its policy limit.
The Release Work Item is archived, its PR is merged, ai-close-work-item verifies merged identity and cleanup, and no release work branch or active Work Item remains.

guidelines: Use only .github/workflows/release.yml for immutable tag and provider Release mutations; never create, move, delete, or republish a release manually.
Preserve readiness → archive/pre-merge freeze → PR merge → same-SHA rehearsal → receipt-bound publication → independent post-publication verification → Work Item closure.
Treat Outcome and chat claims as handoff summaries only; public release truth must come from provider, tag, asset, and command evidence.
Never reuse or mutate a failed immutable tag; quarantine failed provider evidence and use a new corrective patch release if the workflow fails after tag creation.

intent.problem: The accepted Implementation Knowledge feature is merged on main, while the repository still has v0.5.68 only as an unpublished candidate. Adopters need a new immutable version that exposes the completed functionality through the supported installer and public release contract.
constraints: Publish only v0.5.68 from the latest freshly resolved origin/main commit.
Do not rerun or publish v0.5.68 until Issue #901 is resolved and its installer regression evidence is recorded.
Do not rerun or publish v0.5.68 until the observed same-SHA coverage variance is fixed and a fresh source-bound rehearsal passes.
Use the repository's release.yml workflow and its exact-source rehearsal; do not manually mutate tags, Releases, assets, or provider configuration.
Do not claim published or verified until public provider assets and independent post-publication checks agree.
Stop and preserve evidence on any missing, failed, stale, or mismatched gate.
intent.rationale: A new patch release is the requested next step after the existing objectives are complete, and an immutable source-bound release is required for adopters to consume the accepted feature safely. The open installer knowledge-history issue was resolved and verified before resuming release preparation.
